title: Chapter 1031
text:
Among the [Tyracles Mechanical Legacy] blueprints unlocked at level 320, there was a Gold blueprint!

Furthermore, it was not just one but two!

Gold grade represented Universal Treasure-level equipment!

Han Xiao was pleasantly surprised.

This time, it was finally not a Rare Gold item but a true Legendary item!

He originally thought that he would only have a chance of unlocking a Universal Treasure-level blueprint at level 360, but he did not expect it to appear at level 320. The value of this Race Talent was probably higher than he had imagined.

He hurriedly opened the item introduction, and the two blueprints appeared before his eyes.

[Blueprint – Emperor's Robe]: After the Saint Tyracles Race witnessed the greatness of the Mechanical Deity, they fervently researched this Super mechanical creation. This is a set of special equipment that can only be used by the Mechanical Deity.

Han Xiao looked at the blueprints carefully and browsed through the effects of the two pieces of equipment.

The Saint Tyracles Race's attainments in Super machinery were very high. The 'King' mechanical suit had reached the level of a Universal Treasure and incorporated many of the Saint Tyracles Race's advanced technologies.

This mechanical suit was specially made for Beyond Grade A Mechanics. The reference parameters of the blueprint showed that the basic performance of the King was at least thirty percent higher than the mechanical suit he was currently using! One had to know that his current mechanical suit was also a high-level Orange equipment and was among the best of his grade!

Other than normal combat weapons, the King also had unique functions that were extremely suitable for Mechanics.

As a piece of equipment specially made for Mechanics, the King had additional bonuses for Mechanics. It could provide the user with an additional total Machinery Affinity of 1.075, which was only slightly lower than the Divine Mechanical Throne. At the same time, it could increase the radiation range of the Mechanical Force bonus by thirty-five percent and reduce the energy consumption of the Mechanical Force bonus. This would strengthen the endurance of the Mech Legion for normal Mechanics.

Furthermore, the King had a special energy converter that could absorb Mechanical Force and enter a special strengthening state. There were many stages, which greatly improved the mechanical suit's performance. It strengthened its close combat, instant acceleration, and defensive capabilities, allowing it to get rid of the sudden attacks that normal Mechanics were most afraid of.

Although this kind of man-made combat equipment was a Universal Treasure, it did not belong to the category of Space Wonders. Therefore, its quality was more reflected in its powerful performance. Very few of them had unsolvable abilities like the Spacetime Amber. For example, the Universal Treasure level magic equipment made by the Godly Craftsman Thorne belonged to this category.

However … Emperors were an exception.

What made Han Xiaoxin so happy was the core function of the Emperor!

When the Radiant Federation created the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device, they had borrowed some important technology from the Saint Tyracles. The core function of the King was related to this.

The reason why the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device was a strategic weapon of the Radiant Federation was because of its unlimited teleportation ability. Not only was the teleportation distance extremely far, but most importantly, it was immune to all interference from spatial devices. All kinds of interference methods that were effective against normal teleportation were useless against the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device, and the Emperor had a similar effect.

The King had a unique accessory called the Throne. Both sides resonated, and no matter where the King was, it could bring the user back to the location of the Throne instantly. This teleportation ignored external interference, and even if it was targeted by the wormhole countermeasure device or the space stabilization anchor, it would still be effective.

The introduction of this function was' The Emperor is not restricted '.

Not only that, when the Emperor returned to the Throne, it could activate the follow-up effect of this function within three minutes and teleport back to the Emperor's original position, shuttling back and forth between two points … To put it simply, this was jumping left and right.

"With the shadow of the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device, as long as I have this set of Emperors, I won't be afraid of falling into a trap like EsGod. I can return to the Throne at any time and escape danger." Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

Considering his physique that was easily surrounded … this thing was a divine artifact!

Although it was a fixed location teleportation and could not compare to the effect of the Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device, it still had an irreplaceable effect. To a Mechanic with a weak body, this was a divine ability to escape. As the saying went, where there is life, there is hope. This was very suitable for Mechanics.

Han Xiao looked at the manufacturing requirements and pondered.

"The cost is very high, but I can still afford it. Some of the core raw materials are very difficult to obtain, but that's a matter of the exploration era. Now, it's the Galaxy Calendar. As long as I have money, I can always buy these raw materials. I can afford the cost." Han Xiao was not worried about the materials.

As the leader of the Shattered Star Ring Beyond Grade As, the strongest local tyrant of the Flickering World, and the father of thousands of financial groups, his ability to spend money was perfect.

His main concern was the difficulty of manufacturing. Gold Grade Universal Treasure equipment was very difficult to create, and it did not mean that he would definitely be able to create Gold Grade equipment according to the blueprint.

The most likely situation was that the finished product would not reach the level of a Universal Treasure, and there would always be various reasons that would cause the finished product to not reach the ideal state of the blueprint.

"I'm now level 320 and am already a peak Beyond Grade A Mechanic. My basic manufacturing ability will definitely pass. Coupled with the talent provided during the Divine Throne Mechanic Class Advancement, the success rate should not be very low," Han Xiao thought.

During the Class Advancement, Han Xiao had obtained a talent called [Spirit Instrument]. Its effect was to increase the success rate of manufacturing Gold Grade blueprints. Now, it finally had a place to use it.

The other unlocked blueprint, [Emperor's Cape], was a special equipment used by the Mechanical Deity. Simply put, the King was the mechanical suit used by the Mechanic, and the Emperor's Cape was the mechanical suit used by the Mechanical Deity.

It looked like an oversized cape on the outside, and it could reduce the consumption of the Divine Throne Mechanic to maintain the Mechanical Deity, indirectly increasing the combat time of the Mechanical Deity.

Not everyone was as sick as Han Xiao. Normal Mechanics did not have much energy to recover, and the Emperor's Cape was equivalent to a delay spray for the Mechanic, allowing the Mechanical Deity to last longer.

Other than reducing the consumption, it could also provide additional protection and stabilize the interior of the Mechanical Deity. Because the Mechanical Deity was formed from the combination of countless machines, the tightness of the connection affected the defense of the Mechanical Deity.

During the battle with Heber, Ty-Ty had rushed into the hands of the Mechanical Deity, wanting to destroy the Mechanical Deity from the inside. Although it had failed, it had temporarily shattered the right arm of the Mechanical Deity. If not for the fact that Han Xiao recovered his energy at a terrifying rate, just the cost of repairing it would have been enough to make a normal Mechanic weak.

However, with the Emperor's Cape, the interior of the Mechanical Deity would become extremely tough. Even if a peak Beyond Grade A Pugilist invaded its body, it would be able to last longer.

Other than the defensive ability, the Emperor's Cape would also give the Mechanical Deity a movement bonus. The huge size affected the speed of the Mechanical Deity, and the Emperor's Cape could increase the agility and attack speed of the Mechanical Deity.

"Both of these are Gold Equipment specially suitable for Mechanics. As expected of the Tyracles Race, famous for their machinery."

Han Xiao was extremely envious of these two pieces of equipment. After rejecting the dynasty's proposal to exchange for the Evolution Cube, he had thought that he would not have the opportunity to obtain Universal Treasure combat equipment in the short term. The effects of these two blueprints had given him a pleasant surprise. They were both combat equipment that could immediately increase his combat strength, which was exactly what he was currently lacking.

"I have to think of a way to create them quickly. Now that many Beyond Grade As have gathered in the Flickering World, the various organizations also know my strength quite well. If something happens, it will definitely be a huge crisis …"

Han Xiao calmed himself down and looked at his attributes panel after his Promotion.

Standing at the peak, you can see more scenery. This is not the end of the path of evolution. You have to push aside the fog and gradually reach a higher level of life form.
